svg.title: SOCOM Unzipped: status: Sony SDK libraries 88.6%, PS2 hardware 58.1%

g.title: MSL C++ std: 169 functions -- Working. Metrowerks Standard Library (iostreams, locale, ctype, codecvt, string), recompiled as is. No defect or divergence in KNOWN or LATER, and no KNOWN row exercises it -- unverified, which by this map's rule is not partial.
libc (newlib): 165 functions -- Working. Recompiled newlib. KNOWN section 1: 'rand() returned 15 bits over a _rand_next frozen at 41' -- fixed (ede2096).

libkernel: 160 functions -- Working. Syscalls, threads, semaphores, alarms, TLB, ExecPS2. KNOWN section 1: 'Equal-priority time slicing was an ours-only semantic; removed' and 'The online logoff restarts the game in-process' (LoadExecPS2).

libmpeg: 121 functions -- Working. FFmpeg-backed MPEG HLE; movies play on every gate. KNOWN section 1: the intro-movie macroblock race and the MPEG back-pressure gate behind the music dropouts, both fixed. A freeze seen once in Sprint 1 stays a section 2 belief.

libinsck + netglue: 45 functions -- Working. The socket layer under the game's network code. Anchored by the named sceInsockInetAddr (0x1c1348) and sceEENetInetNtoa (0x1c1858); the start 0x1c0948 is inferred (the unnamed functions after libvu0's last, whose sizes match netglue_insck's in ps2recomp's symbol database, third_party/ps2recomp/ps2xAnalyzer/include/ps2recomp/sce_symbol_database_data.h). KNOWN section 1: the hosted online round and 'The online movement blocker was sceInetInterfaceControl(0x200) returning a constant' (fixed).
libm: 43 functions -- Working. fdlibm, recompiled. KNOWN section 2: 'sin/cos have no live call sites' (believed; matters only if their binding were wrong).

libvu0: 40 functions -- Partial. Recompiled since libvu0 was un-stubbed; KNOWN section 1: 'The VU0 vf0 fix restores Frostfire online control'. Partial on a known divergence: LATER 12, issue #47 open (macro-mode MAC/STATUS flags land at once, not with the hardware's latency); the FTOI NaN rule is the fork's (KNOWN section 2).
fileio: 39 functions -- Working. Host and disc file I/O behind the IOP model; every boot reads through it (KNOWN section 1, the from-a-fresh-clone row).

libcdvd: 37 functions -- Working. HLE over your own disc image. KNOWN section 1: 'sceCdRead moved the CD stream cursor; fixed' (the title loop correlates 1.000 with the disc PCM) and the from-a-fresh-clone row (ISO to the title).
sif: 33 functions -- Working. SIF commands and RPC, served by the runtime's IOP model. KNOWN section 1: 'sceSifInitRpc reset the whole IOP model on every call' -- fixed.

iopheap / loadfile: 32 functions -- Working. IOP heap and module loading, answered by the runtime's per-revision IOP profile (KNOWN section 1, 'The launcher started socom2.exe whatever GAME VERSION said': a second IOP profile for r0004).

C++ runtime (MW): 28 functions -- Working. Metrowerks runtime: array new/delete, the overlay manager, dynamic_cast, member pointers. Runs on every boot; the overlays are pre-merged into socom2_game.elf (research/05). No KNOWN row of its own; the gate and the online rounds (KNOWN section 1) rest on it.

deci2 / tty: 28 functions -- Partial. libkernel's debug channel (Deci2, TTY, kprintf). A divergence read from the runtime's code (KNOWN and LATER are silent): the Deci2 calls are TODO stubs (Kernel/Stubs/Deci2.cpp), not a model.

libmc: 28 functions -- Working. EE libmc HLE over a card folder. KNOWN section 1: 'An empty or missing card folder is an inserted, formatted, empty PS2 card', the first-save fix (152579a) and the persona file decoded.
libgcc: 26 functions -- Working. 64-bit integer and soft-double helpers. KNOWN section 1: 'Five soft-double stubs were bound with the wrong ABI' -- fixed (db7a992).

libusbkb: 26 functions -- Pending. No PS2 USB keyboard model: the host keyboard reaches the game as pad input and the on-screen keyboard (docs/HAZARDS.md, 'The harness plays the game with the keyboard'). No KNOWN row.

C++ EH (MW): 20 functions -- Working. Metrowerks exception unwinding, recompiled as is. No defect or divergence in KNOWN or LATER; no KNOWN row shows the game throwing either -- unverified, which by this map's rule is not partial.

libgraph: 20 functions -- Working. KNOWN section 2: 'sceGsSetDefDBuff reads its trailing args from the stack' -- fixed (07ffc0a); the display-environment difference that remains is believed to have no visible effect.

libscf: 20 functions -- Partial. System configuration (language, aspect, time zone, RTC). A divergence read from the config (KNOWN and LATER are silent): stub selectors in recomp/socom2.toml stand in for the console's settings; the game runs in English at its defaults.

libdma: 19 functions -- Working. Every frame's transfers reach the GS; the gate passes 3/3 on every chain (KNOWN section 1). Never compared with a console (LATER 13, 'no defect seen') -- unverified, which by this map's rule is not partial.

libdbc: 18 functions -- Working. Kept idle on purpose: the pads come through the libpad2 HLE, which answers the calls that would reach DBCMAN (socom2_pad2_hle.cpp). The pad drives every gate and ladder run (KNOWN section 1).

libpad2: 15 functions -- Partial. HLE of the first port. Pressure is all or nothing (0xFF), so crouch needs the launcher's shortcut: KNOWN section 1, 'Crouch was unreachable on any PC pad, and now has a shortcut (R139)'.
libmrpc: 9 functions -- Working. msifrpc, the network library's transport (research/10), HLE'd. KNOWN section 1: 'An online round plays end to end on the project's HOSTED Horizon server'.
libipu: 8 functions -- Working. Served by the MPEG HLE with libmpeg. KNOWN section 1: 'The intro-movie macroblocks were a cross-thread race' -- fixed (4a701f1).
libvib: 2 functions -- Pending. No rumble: the pad HLE reports no actuators, so the game sends no vibration (socom2_pad2_hle.cpp). No KNOWN row.

crt0: 1 functions -- Working. The entry point; the restarted guest re-enters it in-process (KNOWN section 1, 'The online logoff restarts the game in-process': guest restarted at 0x180008, reaches the main menu).

rect.title: R5900 CPU, recompiled to C++ -- Working: Every map row recompiles; the gate passes 3/3 on every chain, r0004 too (KNOWN section 1, 'The r0004 build passes the gate 3/3').
Kernel: threads, semaphores, alarms, ExecPS2 -- Working: KNOWN section 1: the priority scheduler ('Equal-priority time slicing ... removed') and the in-process LoadExecPS2 restart.

INTC: VBlank and GS interrupts -- Working: VBlank holds near the console's 16.7 ms; two instances keep the guest clock at real time (KNOWN section 1, 'Two instances hold the guest clock at real time').
DMA controller -- Working: Runs every frame of every gate; never compared with a console (LATER 13, 'no defect seen') -- unverified, which by this map's rule is not partial.
EE timers -- Working: No defect beyond the frame-rate issues #59 and #67 (LATER 10); no console timing oracle, interrupt unit tests only -- unverified, which by this map's rule is not partial.

FPU (COP1) and MMI instructions -- Partial: A known divergence: LATER 11, the FPU translator is plain IEEE with no PS2 clamping (no defect seen from it yet). KNOWN section 2: numeric parity of the generated MMI/VU0 code under NEON (the macOS port) is unproven.
GIF (PATH1-3) -- Working: Runs every frame of every gate; never compared with a console (LATER 13, 'no defect seen') -- unverified, which by this map's rule is not partial.
IPU: the movies -- Working: Through the FFmpeg MPEG HLE; KNOWN section 1, the intro-movie macroblock race fixed.

GS: primitives and framebuffer (OpenGL) -- Partial: Draws every screen, up to 4x resolution. KNOWN section 2: 'The main thread's GL replay stalls for good after a present' (intermittent, #114); LATER 55: no deinterlace, so the 480i output is not field-blended as PCSX2's is.
VIF1 and VU1 -- Partial: Correct on the gate; the cost is the open thread. KNOWN section 2: 'The game thread's own work is what limits the mission's frame rate' (VU1 about 42 %).

GS textures and CLUTs -- Partial: KNOWN section 1: the CLUT texture-cache explosion fixed (2026-09-16). Partial on LATER 54, a known divergence: no mipmap sampling (MIPTBP1/2, MXL, LCM and K stored, never read); and issue #32 open, textures re-decoded far more often than they change (KNOWN section 2).

VU0 (macro and micro mode) -- Partial: KNOWN section 1: 'The VU0 vf0 fix restores Frostfire online control'. Partial on a known divergence: LATER 12, issue #47 open (macro-mode flags land at once, without the hardware's latency); the FTOI NaN rule is the fork's, not hardware-verified (KNOWN section 2).
SIF DMA and RPC -- Working: KNOWN section 1: 'sceSifInitRpc reset the whole IOP model on every call' -- fixed.
CD/DVD drive (your own disc image) -- Working: KNOWN section 1: the from-a-fresh-clone row and the sceCdRead stream-cursor fix.
Memory cards -- Working: KNOWN section 1: an empty folder is a formatted card; the persona file is decoded; the launcher's persona is one the game reads.

Network adapter (DEV9) and the IOP stack -- Working: KNOWN section 1: 'An online round plays end to end on the project's HOSTED Horizon server'. Section 2: no round yet between two different networks.

SPU2 and the 989snd driver (HLE) -- Partial: Music sample-exact (KNOWN section 1, 'Missions are meant to have music'). The lobby track that played once and stopped now loops (fixed 567b127c, ff270d65; 188.5 s proven 2026-10-04). Partial on KNOWN section 2: the mission's ambient bed 7-10 dB under the console (#91), and the login screens' unexplained dips (#94).
Controllers -- Partial: One host pad on the first port; pressure all or nothing (KNOWN section 1, the crouch shortcut row, R139).

USB: the headset and the keyboard -- Partial: The lgaud headset service answers (KNOWN section 2, 'Voice: the headset path, as far as it is proven'); the game does not send voice yet; no USB keyboard.

svg.text: Too small to label: libpad2, libmrpc, libvib, crt0 (in the table)
* One cell per function of the Sony and toolchain libraries statically linked into SCUS_972.75 (the loader, r0001), from the function map ps2_recomp compiles.
Hardware: one rectangle per component, sized by weight. Statuses from docs/KNOWN.md and docs/LATER.md; every reason is in docs/status/detail.md.
† Plain means of the 2026-10-11 audit's category scores, two rows re-scored from KNOWN for Sprint 18's close: eight for the recomp and the game, one for our server.
